framing: A small invariance penalty guarantees domain generalization.
reason: Existing failures distinguish the penalty, invariant predictor and availability of identifying environments.

framing: Increasing graph expansion must improve GNN performance.

framing: Lottery-ticket existence solves efficient sparse training.
reason: Existence, finding tickets, rewinding and total search cost must be separated.

framing: The modality gap has one demonstrated universal cause.
reason: The selected accounts change objectives, temperatures, pair noise and initial conditions. Compare their regimes before calling them contradictory.

framing: Synthetic feedback inevitably collapses or is safe whenever data accumulate.
reason: Replacement, accumulation and fixed-budget sampling have different behavior; fresh-data diffusion bounds add another explicit protocol.

framing: Universal exact conditional coverage is an achievable open target.
reason: Impossibility and positive restricted-class guarantees already exist; specify shift classes, efficiency and supervision budgets.

framing: SAEs have no recovery guarantees; disentanglement is impossible under any assumptions.
reason: Both claims omit existing positive theorems. Retain approximate-misspecification and semantic-validation questions.

framing: Tree models are permanently superior on tabular data.
reason: TabPFN and its follow-up already change the historical benchmark conclusion; the proposed question is now the regime frontier, prior mismatch and explicit amortized compute.

framing: Cross-batch neighbors should be counted as unrelated new subjects.
reason: Explicitly linked plasticity versus forgetting, augmentation versus collapse, attribution versus data selection, and classifier correction versus collapse geometry. Human semantic deduplication remains pending.

framing: Every multi-query search adequately covered every query.
reason: Results were often dominated by one query. Targeted follow-ups were added for graphs, RL, LoRA, MAE, operators and calibration; recent pruning/offline-RL checks remain thin.

framing: Venue search is equivalent to a completed recent-literature audit.
reason: Primary Nature, PMLR and ACL abstracts changed several framings. An OpenReview pruning landing page hit a browser verification gate, so that paper remains an unreviewed search lead; this was not treated as absence of recent pruning work.
